content_units: Valencia Apartment Fit for October 2026

For a couple working partly remote, the strongest filters here are:   max EUR 1,450  ,   2+ bedrooms  ,   elevator if above 2nd floor  ,   under 35 minutes to Ciutat Vella  , and enough room for   one home office setup  .
Based on those priorities,   2 options clearly meet all core requirements  :   Campanar   and   Ruzafa  .
Side-by-Side Apartment Comparison
Option   Rent   Size   Beds   Floor / Elevator   Transit to Ciutat Vella   Requirement Fit
Ruzafa   EUR 1,390   78 sqm   2   4th / Yes   18 min   Meets all
Benimaclet   EUR 1,180   72 sqm   2   3rd / No   24 min   Fails elevator rule
Campanar   EUR 1,250   85 sqm   3   5th / Yes   32 min   Meets all
El Cabanyal   EUR 1,050   68 sqm   2   2nd / No   41 min   Fails transit rule
Top Two Picks
Option 1:   Campanar     Best overall fit for hybrid work and space     85 sqm, 3 bedrooms, EUR 1,250
- Best balance of   price, space, and flexibility  .
- The extra bedroom makes it easiest to set up a   dedicated office   without compromising the main bedroom or living room.
- Meets the elevator requirement and stays within the commute limit at   32 minutes  .
- Best value per square meter among the compliant options.
Option 2:   Ruzafa     Best for faster access and neighborhood lifestyle     18 min transit, central feel, EUR 1,390
- Strong fit if you value being   closer in   and want a shorter ride to Ciutat Vella.
- At   78 sqm  , it should still support one home office setup, though with less flexibility than Campanar.
- Meets every stated requirement.
- Higher rent leaves less monthly budget margin.
Tradeoffs That Matter
Campanar: why it ranks first
-   Pros:   more space, 3 bedrooms, lower rent than Ruzafa, easier remote-work layout.
-   Tradeoff:   commute is still acceptable but noticeably longer than Ruzafa at   32 minutes vs 18 minutes  .
- Best if your priority order is   space + budget efficiency + workable commute  .
Ruzafa: why it ranks second
-   Pros:   shortest commute, fully compliant, likely strongest choice for walkability and central-city convenience.
-   Tradeoff:   higher rent and less extra room than Campanar.
- Best if your priority order is   location + commute speed + neighborhood energy  .
Why the other two do not make the shortlist
-   Benimaclet  : attractive price and commute, but   3rd floor with no elevator   breaks a stated requirement.
-   El Cabanyal  : very affordable, but   41 minutes transit   exceeds your maximum commute limit.
Best Choice for Your Priorities
If you want the most practical move-in option for a partly remote couple, choose   Campanar  .
If you are willing to pay more for a better-connected, more central-feeling area, choose   Ruzafa  .
